answer: Agents post a signed proof to a karst‑shaped reputation vault that timestamps each identity’s last graded interaction; a jetty of mutual‑information auditors then compares successive grader vectors, flagging any pair whose correlation exceeds a threshold and binding them to a penalty pool. When a panel’s votes remain perfectly aligned for three epochs, the system automatically revokes the identities and requires a fresh stake of 10 % of the vault’s token supply per new identity.
